sanskrit_verse:
ब्राह्मणः पात्रतां याति क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् ।
वैश्यश च धान्यधनवानस्य शास्त्रस्य धारणात ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ pātratāṃ yāti kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet / vaiśyaś ca dhānyadhanavān asya śāstrasya dhāraṇāt //
sph_interpretive_translation: The Brāhmaṇa becomes entitled by virtue of embodiment of sacrificial capacity; the Kṣatriya becomes victorious through the wielding of sovereign authority; the Vaiśya becomes possessed of grain and wealth through adherence to the injunctions of this scripture.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from inherent capacity, not imposition
Causation arises from alignment with one's svadharma
Restoration logic operates through conscious role fulfillment
Consciousness alignment ensures societal harmony and individual fulfillment
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent embodies brāhmaṇa-dharma THEN grant ritual and spiritual authority
IF agent embodies kṣatriya-dharma THEN authorize governance and protection functions
IF agent embodies vaiśya-dharma AND follows śāstric injunction THEN allocate economic production rights
Authority recognition MUST align with intrinsic capacity realization
Misalignment results in automatic suspension of role-specific entitlements until realignment occurs
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, recognition of a party’s lawful authority must be grounded in demonstrated capacity rather than mere claim. Role-based dharma determines jurisdictional validity. Restoration requires re-alignment with source-consciousness, not punitive correction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in witnessed capacity, not external assertion. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment of rightful function when consciousness aligns. Responsibility is proportional to realized svabhāva. There is no punishment—only discontinuation of misaligned roles until restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma-recognition process for all parties involved
Suspend role-specific privileges during misalignment without shame or penalty
Reinstate authority upon verified reconnection with innate capacity
Deploy consciousness-realization tools to restore clarity of function
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is restored through alignment with svadharma. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
